model: deterministic software simulator; 16 optical spatial modes and frozen 32-phase mesh, four 24-bit RBG banks, eight visual legs, one oxygen-neutral shared body

test.hashAlgorithm: SHA-256 via WebCrypto on secured origin; browser test on about:blank uses Python hashlib-backed test-only WebCrypto shim

protocol.hiddenEnvironment: deterministic four-bank phase drift with sinusoidal changes, reversals at 48-tick intervals, and software RBG load changes
protocol.controllerInput: detector intensities for current tick only; does not read future drift sequence or direct drift value
protocol.controlAction: one of four bank phase compensators selected each tick, with six bounded candidate probes and hold option
protocol.budget: exactly eight detector intensity measurements per tick
protocol.openLoopComparison: same tick, same environmental drift, zero compensation
protocol.reference: frozen trained phase mesh, neutral RBG register, zero compensator and zero disturbance
protocol.provenance: append-only in-memory SHA-256-linked sequence with genesis parent 64 zeroes; allows export to a JSON file
protocol.timing: recovery latency 4 ticks reflects minimum five-eligible-reading condition and permissive error gate; do not generalize to difficult drift

limitations: The set of drift reversals is predefined; this does not establish recovery under genuinely unforeseen drift.

The 5e-4 MSE recovery gate is permissive relative to the observed average closed-loop MSE; reported 4-tick latencies reflect five-in-a-row rule and are not independently optimized physical response times.
The model calls a synthetic intensity oracle eight times per tick. This assumes probes could be executed within one control interval.
Continuous ticks are logical simulation steps; no measured real-time physical control throughput.
WebCrypto requires a secure origin for the production SHA-256 ledger. The browser test on about:blank used an equivalent SHA-256 callback shim for hashing.
A JavaScript in-memory ledger is tamper-evident to post-hoc edits when independently anchored, not immutable against an adversarial script with full memory access.
Routing activity count is the number of burst/step calls, not verified packets delivered.
Normalized unit input and passive optical network conserve model energy; they do not measure physical efficiency.
next: PHOTON-16 v0.13: pre-register stricter disturbance families, threshold-based decision reliability, physically plausible probe budgets, and holdout-vs-tuned calibration.
